title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Record in PracticePay Returned-Payment-Fee Relief
content:
**Rule.** The FlexLine share of a PracticePay Patient Financing returned-payment-fee relief reads every FlexLine the customer has held: a late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 0.85; a returned payment but no late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 0.95; otherwise the share is 1; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the relief date, a month being whole once the relief date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

The lines read are all of the customer's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, whatever their status.

| FlexLine record, last 12 months | Share |
|---|---|
| a late fee on any FlexLine | 0.85 |
| a returned payment on any FlexLine, no late fee | 0.95 |
| neither | 1 |

*Hypothetical, relief date 10 November.* A FlexLine payment returned on 11 November of the year before is 11 whole months back (the 10th has not reached the 11th) and inside the window: with no FlexLine late fee, the share is 0.95.
